title: Siberia: the route changed
hook: Was the final railway the only route ever considered?

predict.question: Did an earlier route pass through Manchuria?

frames.heading: Amur route
frames.text: Plans favor a route along the Amur.

frames.heading: A shortcut
frames.text: A line through Manchuria shortens the route.

frames.heading: Political exposure
frames.text: The Manchurian connection faces political conflict.

frames.heading: Amur completed
frames.text: The Amur line provides an all-Russian route.

reveal: Terrain and politics changed the railway’s path. The route through Manchuria shortened the journey but exposed it to political changes and conflict. Completion of the Amur line in 1916 supplied a route entirely within Russia’s territory at the time. Infrastructure routes reflect choices as well as distance.
limit: Selected eastern corridors, not the complete railway or modern borders.
